m.d: Europe is a northern continent near Asia and Africa.
m.e: The United Kingdom, France, and Spain are all in Europe.

m.d: A European is a person from Europe.
If something is European, it is from or related to Europe.
Eugene is a male given name.
Official name of the money used in 15 countries of Europe.
Euro is another way of spelling euro. An Euro is the currency used by the European Union.
A eunuch is a castrated human male.
A cry of joy or satisfaction when one finds or discovers something.
m.e: The answer hit me. "Eureka!", I cried.

m.d: A eulogy is a speech, or writing, which praises someone who has died.
Euphoria is a state of mind. It means happiness, ecstasy, optimism, all beyond normal everyday life.
m.e: In a state of euphoria, he bet his house on the turn of a card.

m.d: A moon orbiting Jupiter. It can have life.
Euphemism is the substitution of a mild, indirect, or vague expression for one thought to be offensive, harsh, or blunt.
An euphemism is a word or a phrase used to replace another to make it less offensive.
m.e: "To pass away” is a euphemism for "to die".
